title: FuelRecord
status_note: Field list verbatim from DISPATCH_BUILD_BLUEPRINT_v1 Part 1.2. The blueprint itself marks Decision D1 (dual-record fuel) 'ADOPTED [MIKE APPROVES]', but its own header defines [MIKE APPROVES] as 'drafted for his sign-off, not yet law.' The later, dated approval record (DISPATCH_MATRIX_EXECUTION_PACKAGE_v1 / docs/decisions/DECISION_LOG.md) lists #2 as HELD as of 2026-08-03. This file follows the Decision Log: NOT frozen. No fuel_records table may be created and no FuelRecord may be written while this file carries DRAFT status.

expense_record_id.description: OPEN — the D1 cross-link. The blueprint drafts this as required; that requirement IS decision #2, not yet adopted. Do not build against this field until Mike decides.

jurisdiction.description: State/province code, derived from vendor_address. Never guessed.

routing_note: Reefer-flagged fuel emits an ExpenseRecord only (category reefer_fuel), no FuelRecord — per blueprint 1.2 D1. DEF is never a FuelRecord under any circumstance.
